evidence: Both quotes found verbatim: Architect's Question "at the canonical low-batch operating point, decode is HBM-bandwidth-bound while prefill is compute-bound — and that this is a regime statement, not a universal rule" (the qualifier is printed inline) and §3 "decode shard 70B/8 = 8.75B params = 17.5 GB/GPU per step → 17.5 GB / 3.35 TB/s = 5.2 ms, inside the 25 ms TPOT budget". The finding's arithmetic checks: 17.5 GB ÷ 25 ms = 700 GB/s = 21% of 3.35 TB/s; saturation above ~4.8 sequences/GPU (3.35e3 × 0.025 / 17.5 = 4.79); compute-bound above ~295 (989e12 × 0.00522 / (2×8.75e9) = 295.4); prefill AI ~9.2K ≫ ridge ~295 ✓.
